# ClipDows
> ClipDows is a clipboard manager for Windows by Ayushmanbuilds. It saves text, links, images, code and files you copy, searches inside screenshots offline, and syncs end-to-end encrypted to your phone.

## Key facts
- Platform: Windows desktop app plus a phone web app (PWA)
- Plans: Free, Pro, Max. New accounts get a 14-day Pro trial
- Privacy: clips are encrypted before upload; passwords, OTPs, cards and API keys are masked and never synced
- Shortcuts: Alt+C show/hide, Ctrl+F search, Ctrl+Alt+C start Paste stack, Ctrl+Alt+V paste in order
